notes: LIT = THE LOAD SWITCH IS DELIVERING: it hangs on the LT1641's output (UMBILICAL_POS12), so it goes dark with the toggle off and when the -1 latches on a fault - the one thing the panel has to say. It does not say the instrument is plugged in; that is the instrument's to report. Lite-On LTST-C171GKT, LCSC C913075 [ds LITEON-LTST-C171GKT-0805-GREEN.pdf; web LCSC 2026-10-01]: GaP green 565 nm, VF 2.1 typ 2.4 max at 20 mA, 0.80 tall. ON THE MAIN BOARD'S FRONT FACE, centred under MECH-LED-BEZEL-MOD, the panel light pipe (ADR 0024 point 15; mechanical/module/export/pcb-geometry.echo 'LED-PANEL'). Brightness through the pipe at its current is unmeasured: the first build, looked at
About 4.5 mA from the load switch's output (UMBILICAL_POS12), on the main board beside LED-PANEL. Not from the analog +12 V: that rail is live whenever the rack is, so the LED could not show a latch
